title: Somaliland President Irro Offers Berbera Port, Minerals and Possible US/Israeli Base Access for Recognition
detail: In an exclusive interview published September 16, 2026, Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi 'Irro' told Semafor he is putting 'everything on the table' during his Washington visit to secure US recognition of Somaliland's independence, offering access to Berbera port and its free zone, mineral resources and marine-economy opportunities. Asked whether he would rule out a US or Israeli military base in Somaliland, Irro said 'I will not rule out' such an arrangement, calling it 'a negotiation' contingent on what Somaliland receives in return — recognition, security assistance and support for its armed forces. Berbera sits on the Gulf of Aden near the Bab-el-Mandeb strait. 'We are not giving anything for free. We have to offer something,' Irro said. Mogadishu rejects Somaliland's sovereignty claim and considers Berbera, its coastline and its resources part of the Federal Republic of Somalia; the offer follows Israel's December 2025 recognition of Somaliland, the only UN member state to do so.

media.caption: Somaliland President Irro says he is putting 'everything on the table' for US recognition, including possible base access at Berbera, Sep 16, 2026
